selected.name: Phoebe Bridgers
selected.description: Phoebe Bridgers is an American singer-songwriter known for her emotive indie rock and folk music.

properties.description: Founded in 1973, this company is a pioneer in technical outdoor apparel, recognized for its unwavering commitment to environmental and social responsibility. It produces high-performance gear designed for durability, famously encouraging customers to repair rather than replace products. Operating as a purpose-driven entity, it allocates significant resources and profits toward grassroots environmental activism and planetary conservation. The brand holds a unique position as a leader in the sustainable fashion sector, effectively blending technical expertise with a radical philosophy centered on long-term ecological impact.
properties.short_description: Patagonia is an outdoor apparel company known for sustainable clothing and gear for activities like climbing, surfing, skiing, and trail running.

properties.description: An American nonprofit media organization providing high-quality journalism, investigative reporting, and arts and cultural programming. Founded in 1970, it operates as a major public broadcasting institution, connecting listeners through a network of member stations and digital platforms. It is widely recognized for its objective, in-depth approach to national and international affairs. The entity serves a broad, informed audience committed to civic engagement and lifelong learning.
properties.short_description: NPR is a nonprofit media organization known for its news, cultural programming, and music content, including the popular Tiny Desk Concert series.

properties.description: Operating as a consumer cooperative, this organization provides a wide range of outdoor equipment, apparel, and footwear while emphasizing expert guidance and community involvement. It distinguishes itself through a focus on environmental stewardship and sustainable business practices, aiming to connect people with the natural world. With a legacy dating back to 1938, the brand serves as a central hub for outdoor enthusiasts ranging from weekend hikers to serious mountaineers. It maintains a strong reputation for reliability and quality, reinforcing its position as a staple in the North American outdoor recreation market.
properties.short_description: REI is a retail co-op specializing in outdoor gear, clothing, and equipment, promoting a life outdoors since 1938.

properties.description: Starbucks is a leading multinational coffeehouse chain known for its signature roasts, handcrafted beverages, and focus on creating a welcoming community atmosphere. Founded in Seattle’s Pike Place Market in 1971, the brand has grown into a global institution that prioritizes human connection alongside high-quality coffee. Its business model relies on a widespread retail footprint, offering a consistent customer experience for millions of daily visitors worldwide. The company remains focused on ethical sourcing and professional barista training to maintain its market position as the standard-bearer for accessible, premium café experiences.
properties.short_description: Starbucks is a global coffee company known for its handcrafted beverages, coffee products, and café experience.

properties.description: Established in 1977, this fashion brand has become a dominant force in the casual apparel market, recognized for its extensive selection of denim and trend-driven wardrobe staples. It operates with a focus on inclusivity and comfort, providing diverse fits for a young demographic. The brand's retail strategy combines a strong digital presence with widespread physical store locations to maintain accessibility. By maintaining a balance between timeless denim and seasonal trends, it remains a primary destination for Gen Z and young adult consumers.
properties.short_description: American Eagle Outfitters is a fashion brand offering men's and women's jeans, tops, bottoms, activewear, loungewear, and accessories.
